items.evidence: apiLevel 2.15 with metadata; all volumes (18, 1, 10 µL mix) handled by p20 within its 1–20 µL range, labware loaded with the required labels, and simulator checks (no_overdispense, end_state) all pass.

One tip is reused for master mix into empty wells, a fresh tip is picked and dropped per well for colony and primer steps; tip_before_aspirate, no_cross_contamination and tip_dropped_at_end checks pass.

Steps 1–3 are done in order with 18/1/1 µL, a 3x mix after the colony dispense, and the seal and thermocycling program recorded by protocol.comment; nothing extra was added and the comments match the code.
The loop over all 96 PCR wells aspirates 18 µL from reservoir A1 and dispenses it into each well; the end_state:pcr_plate check passes.
The p20 transfers 1 µL from colony[n] and 1 µL from primers[n] into the matching pcr[n] for all 96 wells, with a fresh tip each time; end-state checks pass.
The final protocol.comment records sealing and the program: 98C 30 s; [98C 10 s, 60C 30 s, 72C 30 s] x 30; 72C 2 min; hold 4C.

judge.summary: The protocol simulates cleanly and every measured check passes. All steps use the correct volumes, wells, pipette and tip handling, and the thermocycling program is recorded by comment.
